events.region: Western and Central Chouteau County; Judith Basin County and Judith Gap; Fergus County below 4500ft; Little Belt and Highwood Mountains
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1050 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms
along a line extending from near Geyser to near Stanford. Movement
was northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Stanford, Denton, Geyser, Coffee Creek, and Square Butte.

events.region: Cochise, AZ
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...North Central Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 1130 PM MST.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous flows over low-water crossings. Some low-water
crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 933 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This will cause small stream flooding. Between 0.5
and 1.2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Willcox, Pearce-Sunsites, Cochise and Kansas Settlement.
- This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 42 and 66. Interstate 10 between
mile markers 331 and 343. Route 186 between mile markers 327 and
333.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: El Paso, TX
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Eastern El Paso County in western Texas...

* WHEN...Until midnight MDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. Ponding of water in urban or other areas is
occurring or is imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1005 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall of up to 0.5 inches is expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Far East El Paso, Horizon City and Homestead Meadows.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
